items.title: Can Tho police prosecute 'famous shop' owners for selling fake Gucci, Dior, LV goods
items.summary: Can Tho City police opened 4 criminal cases against 5 suspects for industrial-property-rights infringement, seizing 7,370 counterfeit items (clothing, shoes, bags, wallets, belts) worth over 3.8 billion dong bearing Gucci, Dior, Louis Vuitton, Hermes and Burberry marks. Items are being forensically verified by Vietnam's National Institute of Intellectual Property rather than judged on appearance alone. Critical-angle counterfeit/enforcement story, logged as community-interest news on brand authenticity risk in the region.

items.title: Financial press follow-up on 'famous shop' counterfeit Gucci/Hermes prosecutions
items.summary: Business-financial outlet Vietstock's earlier coverage of the same Can Tho counterfeit-shop prosecution thread (originating investigation predates the Oct 8 charging article above), noting the shops had publicly marketed items as genuine Gucci and Hermes merchandise. Included only as corroborating background for the Oct 8 item; outside the strict freshness window on its own and not counted toward buzz volume, flagged here for traceability.

items.title: Ho Ngoc Ha sets attendance record at Gucci's Milan 'The Store Show'
items.summary: Vietnamese entertainment press covers singer Ho Ngoc Ha's fifth Milan appearance as Gucci's sole Vietnamese 'Friend of the House' at the Spring/Summer 2027 'The Store Show', styled in a Gucci Core look; piece notes Chinese ambassadors and Park Gyu Young drew the most consistent praise from fashion bloggers at the same show. Representative of the steady ambassador-activation coverage dominating Vietnamese entertainment media's Gucci coverage this cycle.

items.title: Ho Ngoc Ha 'shines' in Milan, Gucci CEO greets her personally
items.summary: Follow-up Vietnamese coverage of the same Gucci Store Show appearance, highlighting a personal greeting from Gucci CEO Francesca Bellettini and an interaction with Pia Wurtzbach; wore a brown fur coat with a Gucci Starlet bag. No visible reader comments or critical reaction in the piece; purely celebratory activation coverage.

items.title: Esquire Thailand interviews Billkin on investing, identity and relationships
items.summary: Thai edition of Esquire runs a lifestyle interview with Gucci Thai ambassador Billkin Putthipong Assaratanakul, photographed in a Gucci Primavera look; interview focuses on his investment choices and personal life rather than the brand directly, but visually reinforces his Gucci ambassador status to Thai readers this week.

items.title: SEA fan accounts amplify Gucci ambassador appearances from Milan Store Show
items.summary: Thai and Vietnamese fan/stan accounts on X continue resharing official Gucci posts and photo sets of SEA-linked ambassadors (Gulf Kanawut, Billkin, Ho Ngoc Ha) from the Milan 'The Store Show' cycle; volume is fandom-driven engagement rather than organic public commentary, magnitude-damped per sentiment rubric. No public like/repost counts could be retrieved (X post detail pages returned access-restricted responses), so engagement fields are null.

items.title: Kering confirms Q3 2026 results date of October 28, raising regional-performance watch
items.summary: Financial wire coverage confirms Kering will report Q3 2026 revenue on October 28, with analysts and regional retail press flagging continued Asia-Pacific softness (including Southeast Asia) as the key swing factor after prior quarters showed double-digit declines concentrated in the region; no new figures yet, but sets expectations ahead of the print. Included as T1 financial-calendar context rather than a performance verdict.
